lessons.title: 1. Hello Java & String Variables
lessons.description: Welcome to Java! Java is a strongly-typed, object-oriented language. Create a class `Solution` with a static method `getLanguage()` returning "Java".
learning_objectives: Declare a Java class and return a String literal

exercises.question: Which keyword sends a value back to the caller of a Java method?
exercises.explanation: In Java, the 'return' keyword sends a result back from a method.

exercises.question: Complete the return statement so the method gives back the language name:
exercises.explanation: Java String literals use double quotes, e.g., "Java".

exercises.title: Implement getLanguage()
exercises.question: Implement static method getLanguage() returning 'Java'.

mastery_exam.question: Which Java type does a method declare when it produces a whole number?
mastery_exam.explanation: The method signature declares String as its return type.

mastery_exam.question: Type the Java String literal for Java: String lang = ___;
mastery_exam.explanation: Java String literals are wrapped in double quotes.

source.name: Oracle Java Tutorials — Defining Methods

lessons.title: 2. Integers & Arithmetic
lessons.description: In Java, integers use the `int` primitive type. Create a method `calculateTotal(int price, int quantity)` returning `price * quantity`.
learning_objectives: Use primitive int type and arithmetic in Java

lessons.title: 3. Coffee Shop Order Billing
lessons.description: Calculate total order cost including sales tax: multiply `itemPrice` by `count`, then apply `taxRate` as a fraction.
learning_objectives: Combine double primitive math and casting in Java

tests.name: test_calculate_bill
tests.test_code: double bill = Solution.calculateBill(4.0, 2, 0.10); if (Math.abs(bill - 8.80) > 0.001) throw new AssertionError("Expected 8.80");

lessons.title: 4. Temperature Conversion (Practice)
lessons.description: Convert Fahrenheit temperature to Celsius using `(fahrenheit - 32) * 5 / 9`.

tests.name: test_conversion
tests.test_code: double c = Solution.fahrenheitToCelsius(212.0); if (Math.abs(c - 100.0) > 0.001) throw new AssertionError("Expected 100.0");

mastery_exam.question: Which type represents an integer in Java?
mastery_exam.explanation: int is the primitive type for whole numbers in Java.
